# Dental Home Family Dentistry

> > Comprehensive family dental practice in Phoenix, AZ offering preventive, restorative, and specialized treatments including sedation dentistry and same-day crowns.

Dental Home Family Dentistry is a full-service dental practice in Phoenix, Arizona, led by Dr. Edward Furlong. The practice emphasizes patient comfort through advanced sedation options and modern dental technology including intraoral scanners and CEREC CAD/CAM systems.
